items.source:
Annotation to automatically register the following beans for usage with Spring MVC. Note that using this annotation will require Spring 3.2.
  • DomainClassConverter - to allow usage of domain types managed by Spring Data repositories as controller method arguments bound with PathVariable or RequestParam.
  • PageableHandlerMethodArgumentResolver - to allow injection of Pageable instances into controller methods automatically created from request parameters.
  • SortHandlerMethodArgumentResolver - to allow injection of Sort instances into controller methods automatically created from request parameters.
If Spring HATEOAS is present on the classpath we will register the following beans:
  • HateoasPageableHandlerMethodArgumentResolver - instead of PageableHandlerMethodArgumentResolver
  • HateoasSortHandlerMethodArgumentResolver - instead of SortHandlerMethodArgumentResolver
  • PagedResourcesAssembler - for injection into web components
  • SortHandlerMethodArgumentResolver - for injection of PagedResourcesAssembler into controller methods
items.translation:
用于自动注册以下 Bean 以便与 Spring MVC 配合使用的注解。请注意，使用该注解需要 Spring 3.2 版本。
  • DomainClassConverter - 允许将 Spring Data 仓库管理的域类型用作与 PathVariable 或 RequestParam 绑定的控制器方法参数。
  • PageableHandlerMethodArgumentResolver - 允许自动将 Pageable 实例注入到由请求参数创建的控制器方法中。
  • SortHandlerMethodArgumentResolver - 允许自动将 Sort 实例注入到由请求参数创建的控制器方法中。
如果类路径中存在 Spring HATEOAS，我们将注册以下 Bean：
  • HateoasPageableHandlerMethodArgumentResolver - 替代 PageableHandlerMethodArgumentResolver
  • HateoasSortHandlerMethodArgumentResolver - 替代 SortHandlerMethodArgumentResolver
  • PagedResourcesAssembler - 用于注入到 Web 组件中
  • SortHandlerMethodArgumentResolver - 用于将 PagedResourcesAssembler 注入到控制器方法中

items.source: Configures how to render PageImpl instances. Defaults to EnableSpringDataWebSupport.PageSerializationMode.DIRECT for backward compatibility reasons. Prefer explicitly setting this to EnableSpringDataWebSupport.PageSerializationMode.VIA_DTO, or manually convert PageImpl instances before handing them out of a controller method, either by manually calling new PagedModel<>(page) or using Spring HATEOAS PagedModel abstraction.
items.translation: 配置如何渲染 PageImpl 实例。出于向后兼容的考虑，默认值为 EnableSpringDataWebSupport.PageSerializationMode.DIRECT。建议显式将其设置为 EnableSpringDataWebSupport.PageSerializationMode.VIA_DTO，或者在从控制器方法返回之前手动转换 PageImpl 实例，方法是直接调用 new PagedModel<>(page) 或使用 Spring HATEOAS 的 PagedModel 抽象。

items.source: Registers a bean definition for SpringDataWebSettings carrying the configuration values of EnableSpringDataWebSupport.
items.translation: 注册一个用于承载 EnableSpringDataWebSupport 配置值的 SpringDataWebSettings Bean 定义。
